limitations: Synthetic labels and translations have not been independently reviewed.
Other-family careers provisionally receive tier 4; cross-family relevance needs review.
Translations and seniority variants are repeated career measurements.
Markdown text path only; this suite does not validate PDF/DOCX extraction.
Ablations are offline diagnostics, not production changes.

ablationDefinitions.withoutDictionary: Redistribute the skill weight proportionally across production semantic/lexical weights.
ablationDefinitions.semanticOnly: Order by the production normalized semantic component.
ablationDefinitions.coverageWeightedDictionary: Multiply the production skill weight by the fraction of extracted requirement drafts with at least one dictionary term, and redistribute the remainder proportionally. A vocabulary-coverage proxy, not verified requirement understanding.
